article_notes: Study of 40 dogs with clinical signs of hepatitis in Kerala, India; 9 had babesiosis (B. gibsoni, smear diagnosis). Haematology and biochemistry of the babesiosis dogs (Tables 2 and 3) are compared only against laboratory reference values by one-sample t-test. No severity grouping or outcome comparison. Counted the 13 babesiosis markers tested against reference values as skipped (equivalent to infected vs healthy).
